# europeana

Digitised drawings from European museums, archives and libraries, published through Europeana. Each file
keeps the licence its holder attached to the record (table below). Credit each file as given.
CC BY-NC files: non-commercial use only. CC BY-SA and BY-NC-SA files: adaptations you share must use the
same licence.

Changes: files renamed; large scans downscaled to at most 3,000 px and saved as JPEG.
